_about: Eyeball ground truth written by looking at raw frames of ptz_parking (not at the ledger output): contact sheets evidence/eye_A.jpg and evidence/eye_B.jpg, frame times in seconds of the clip. 'present'/'absent' = what I saw inside the car's box; 'blind' = the car is not in the picture at all.

ptz_parking.note: Real clip. The camera view is steady 0 to 02:37, tours a lamp-post close-up 02:38 to 03:57, returns panned ~570 px at ~04:00 (settled about 04:10). There is also a hard cut in the footage at 01:08 (68.2 s): the black Audi right of car A is in the shot at 66 s and gone at 70 s.

person_close.what: a man walks up to the car's front-left corner at 138 s (also at the frame bottom at 125 s, far away)

ambiguous.107: another car drives across the spot

blind_window_ptz.what: camera tours a close-up of a lamp post; verified by eye at 162, 200, 236 s
